description: This Java class, DataSourcePopulator, initializes an in-memory database for a Document Management System (DMS) with schema creation, sample data, user roles, and permissions, including ACL setup and sample directory/file creation.

classes.name: DataSourcePopulator
classes.description: A class that populates a database with schema, sample users, roles, ACLs, directories, and files for a Document Management System.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes database schema, inserts sample users and roles, sets up ACLs, and creates sample directory and file data.

methods.name: createSampleData
methods.description: Creates user-specific directories and subdirectories with permissions and sample files.

methods.name: createFiles
methods.description: Creates a specified number of sample files within a directory.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Stub method intended for subclasses to add permissions to elements.
